We offer:- Empowerment:  You own your projects from proposal development to steering committee presentations, and project closure. Project assignments are matched with your individual development goals and reflect your level of seniority. You will be able to directly experience the impact your work has on our business and patients worldwide.- Career development:   Your leadership in challenging consulting projects will give you high visibility across our business sectors, allowing you to cultivate a deep internal network and ultimately positioning you for a successful transition into your next chapter within our company. While advancing your own professional growth, you simultaneously invest in mentoring and developing junior colleagues.- Flexibility of work:  You will experience our high-impact culture with less business travel and more flexible work arrangements than in external consulting. Moreover, we run a hybrid workplace approach with a healthy mix of remote work and office presence.Who you are:- Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Data Science, Information Systems, Economics, Management with data-focus, or related field- Work experience of 3-5 years in management consulting with a genuine passion for the frontiers of AI and digital innovation, ideally in healthcare, life science, or electronics- Strong understanding of business strategy combined with deep conceptual knowledge of modern AI and data ecosystems – including LLM frameworks, agentic AI architectures, RAG, and multi-agent orchestration – with the ability to assess technical feasibility and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences- Proven ability to translate AI concepts into actionable solutions and drive implementation from discovery through iterative delivery – orchestrating AI workflows, copilots, and autonomous agents into business processes using agile frameworks (Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent) and tooling such as Azure DevOps- Ability to foster a culture of collaboration, curiosity, and responsible AI use within the team- Awareness of AI governance principles, ethical AI practices, and emerging regulatory frameworks (e.g., EU AI Act) is a plus- Strong track record of leading projects across multiple functional areas with exposure to different hierarchical levels. More extensive leadership experience is a plus- Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills including the ability to translate technical AI concepts for executive and non-technical audiences- Proactive, self-motivated work approach with a passion for working in teams- Proficiency in English and preferably also in German- Willingness to relocate to Rhine-Main-Area (e.g., Darmstadt, Frankfurt) to allow for regular office presence (2-3 days per week) for close collaboration and network buildingWhat we offer:We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!

jobs.occupation: Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe (Steuerberater/in)
jobs.description: Who we areWorldline helps businesses of all shapes and sizes to accelerate their growth journey - quickly, simply, and securely. We are the innovators at the heart of the payments technology industry, shaping how the world pays and gets paid. Our technology powers the growth of millions of businesses across 5 continents. And just as we help our customers accelerate their business, we are committed to helping our people accelerate their careers. Together, we shape the evolution.The opportunityAt Worldline, our technology addresses persistent challenges of the payment world. We design and operate leading digital payment and transactional solutions that enable sustainable economic growth and reinforce trust and security in our societies. If you are a highly-skilled Tax director, specialized in German and Swiss tax, then get ready to join our company.This role will report to the Group Head of Tax.Day-to-day responsibilitiesAs a Regional Head (m,w,d) of Tax, Central and Eastern Europe, which include main entities notably in Germany, Switzerland, Austria and Poland, you will be in charge of all the tax aspects related to this perimeter that can evolve depending on the activity. You will be the key contact and stakeholder of local accounting, controlling, legal and finances teams, as well as the main interlocutor for local tax authorities. You will also work closely with the group tax team in order to ensure proper implementation of group tax policy and strategy.Your key responsibilities include:- Manage tax aspects of subsidiaries mainly in Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Poland (including country-specific tax structuring, transfer pricing compliance, limitation of interest deductibility, and local tax consolidation group) and compliance aspects, as CIT, VAT, local taxes returns and ensure compliance with local regulations.- Support local finance teams for annual financial statements under IFRS and local accounting rules (German HGB, Austrian UGB, Swiss GAAP); ensure correct and optimal application of IFRS, translating IFRS and tax standards into practical processes used across administrations.- Take ownership of tax processes at Group level for the Tax Cluster area and ensure coordination between local teams, Group Finance, and external advisors (including transfer pricing documentation, foreign tax credits, local incentives, and subsidies)- Provide advice and support to group tax team, finance, legal and operational teams on  tax matters including CIT, VAT, and country-specific taxes and compliance requirements. Identify issues and drive effective solutions- Conduct tax monitoring across the Tax Cluster perimeter, build local tax manuals and guides that are user friendly and understandable to a larger audience; train local finance and tax teams when required- Ensure management of tax audits and litigations as well as relationships with tax authorities in each jurisdiction: prepare, coordinate and validate responses (with support from external advisors if necessary).- Anticipate and assess tax risks across the Tax cluster perimeter, considering local regulatory changes and multi-country implications and work closely with group tax team in this respect. Identify issues and drive effective solutions- Support the group and local finance teams on reporting (budget/actuals/forecast), on the determination of tax results, current and deferred tax charges and VAT recovery ratio across all  Tax Cluster entities, coordinate the tax reporting and tax package process with local stakeholders, automate and improve processes, and harmonize local submissions as appropriate.- Monitor tax legislation and case law developments and ensure proactive adaptation.This list is non-exhaustive and is intended to evolve with the position and the person who joins the team.Who are we looking forWe look for big thinkers. People who can drive positive change, step up and show what’s next – people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow.- Minimum 12 years of experience within international direct taxation at Big4, international law firm or at a multinational organization; pursued graduation from university (Tax Law or Tax Economics).- Professional proficiency of English and German is required- Expert in Excel and good knowledge of reporting tool (SAP)- You demonstrate expertise in international Group tax matters, leveraging your previous experience.- You are diligent, independent, proactive, with strong analytical and synthesis abilities, and excellent written communication skills. - You take initiative, bring forward strategic proposals, and have strong interpersonal capabilities.- Knowledge of the payments, eCommerce or FinTech industry is a plus.Perks & BenefitsAt Worldline you’ll get the chance to be at the heart of the global payments technology industry and shape how the world pays and gets paid. On top of that, you will also:- Be part of a company guided by a strong purpose to do good and recognized as top 1% of the most sustainable companies in all sectors worldwide- Work with inspiring colleagues and be empowered to learn, grow and accelerate your career- An exciting salary- At Worldline our top priority is to engage, encourage and develop you to help you improve your potential. In fact, we have comprehensive training and development programs in place demonstrating our dedication to developing your career- And many more...#LI-AB1Shape the evolutionWe are on an exciting journey towards the next frontiers of payments technology, and we look for big thinkers, people with passion, can-do attitude and a hunger to learn and grow. Here you'll work with ambitious colleagues from around the world, take on unique challenges as a team, and make a real impact on the society. With an empowering culture, strong technology and extensive training opportunities, we help you accelerate your career - wherever you decide to go. Join our global team of 18,000 innovators and shape a tomorrow that is yours to own. Learn more about life at Worldline at jobs.worldline.comWe are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as an individual with a disability, or any applicable legally protected characteristics.Ergänzende Informationen:Anforderungen an den Bewerber: Erweiterte Kenntnisse: International Accounting/Financial Reporting Standards (IAS/IFRS), Rechnungslegung nach HGBExpertenkenntnisse: Tabellenkalkulation Excel (MS Office)

Embedded in cross-functional project teams, you will guide peers and senior stakeholders — shaping the scientific direction of your projects.This position is limited for two years.Who You Are:- You hold a degree or equivalent qualification in Pharmacokinetics, Pharmaceutical or Biotechnological Sciences, Biomedical or Chemical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related biological or chemical discipline; a doctoral degree with relevant industry experience is typical for this level.- You bring substantial professional experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with deep expertise in PK/PD concepts across drug discovery and development — including translational sciences and regulatory requirements for biotherapeutics such as ADCs, AOCs, and multispecific biologics.- You have hands-on experience with quantitative modeling approaches, including M&S tools, population PK software, QSP platforms, or programming environments such as Python or R; experience with AI/ML applications in drug development is a strong advantage.- You possess a solid understanding of adjacent disciplines — including pharmacology, toxicology, nonclinical safety, drug design, and bioanalytics — and can integrate insights across these areas to guide biotherapeutic engineering and optimization.- You communicate complex scientific concepts clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including cross-functional project teams and senior stakeholders, and are comfortable influencing decisions without direct authority.- You are fluent in written and spoken English; proficiency in German or Italian is an advantage.- You bring strong organizational skills, intercultural awareness, and the ability to manage multiple project commitments with a high degree of autonomy.What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences.
